## ee5ca325d03d

**Issue found: the structural validator rejects canonical inputs and an advertised branch is dead.** Running `self_check` on the five public inputs rejects two of them with `red touches grid border in normal generation`, including the canonical 10×10 frame touching the top/left boundary. The selected Racket rule handles those scenes correctly, so this is an over-tight generator contract rather than an authority limitation.

A second reproducible defect is that `frame_kind="U_shape"` and `frame_kind="rect_outline"` return byte-identical grids for the same seed and overrides: `_draw_frame_kind` calls `draw_rect_outline` in both branches. This makes the advertised U-shape coverage false and leaves a rectangle-only teaching shortcut unchallenged. Unknown override keys are also silently accepted. A future repair should first accept all canonical boundary cases, then either implement a genuinely open/U-shaped lawful object with a precise rule justification or remove that axis value.
